method: Read all171 complete individual propositions, all35 exact context profiles and all three literal caption scopes against full controlling base/source passages. Verify all1079 ordered original occurrence bindings and exact insertion-split fragments. Fourteen independent corrections distinguish fixed cardinality, presence/link predicates, preserved timing/future guards, exact release decision branches and artifact-currentness from actual current computation. Eight primary controllingText representations omit two source-leading spaces while their exact source hashes include them; all originals and exact bindings are preserved and individually qualified. Proposal custody references preserve the exact private Library receipt with no remote readback claim; no implementation/test/proof or source-generator content was consulted

decisions.PRESERVED_METRIC_DIAGNOSTICS: Preserve each exact diagnostic purpose and operational metric category, no new release threshold, and the ban on presenting browser-local observations as population-wide telemetry. Names of accepted/execution/evidence/independence counts do not certify any actual count; actual current metric derivations are separately changed.
decisions.EXACT_METRIC_MUTATION_SUPPORT_GOVERNOR: Preserve each of the three original metric-publication, Stage07-completion and Support captions with its exact governed occurrence ranges and literal governing IDs. No adjacent independent statement or amendment text is absorbed into these original scopes.
decisions.PRESERVED_METRIC_TRANSPARENCY: Every coverage/completion/agreement/stability/reliability/zero metric retains explicit identity/version, closed universe, numerator/denominator, included/excluded IDs/reasons, current scope/evidence and value/disposition. Missing records cannot remove themselves from a denominator. Empty universes need their current independently reviewed evidence-supported determination; never automatic 100 percent.
decisions.PRESERVED_FALSE_POSITIVE_REVIEW: For every mandatory requirement, retain the architect responsibility and each exact false-compliance, boundary, partial-success, stale-state, malformed-input, incorrect-authority, wrong-artifact and capability-substitution challenge category, plus assignment to ordinary verification or Stage07. New concrete cases do not change these coverage categories or confer execution.
decisions.PRESERVED_REGRESSION_INVARIANTS: Preserve each failure fixture, exact reproduction, detection method, correction and permanently active status unless legitimately retired. Fixture creation and hypothetical would-detect claims are not execution; one observation cannot establish both pre-correction failure and later success. Current real pre/post execution bindings are separately changed.
decisions.PRESERVED_ISOLATION_PERMISSIONS: Every exact negative/mutation/adversarial/storage/parser/invalid fixture remains within disposable clone/namespace/read-only copy/worker or expressly authorized bounded sandbox. Canonical user projects and third-party targets need exact separate authorization and safe bounds. F1 expressly preserves this permission boundary.
decisions.PRESERVED_RETIREMENT_AUTHORITY: Preserve ACTIVE/SUPERSEDED/RETIRED, required human authorization, current NOT_APPLICABLE, independent review, append-only record, UNKNOWN blocking and history retention. Failure, inconvenience, cost, unavailability and flakiness never alone justify retirement. Actual current evidential legitimacy/dependency checks are separately changed.
decisions.PRESERVED_SHARED_EVALUATOR_AND_RETRY: Stages11/17/19 share one evaluator across each named count/context/candidate/contamination/output/receipt/matrix/independence/comparison/defect/RCA/regression/variance/convergence/confirmation/diagnostic concern; no duplicated mathematics. Exact failed-attempt exclusion, reservation termination/re-reservation, fresh replacement context, superseded historical exclusion, no accepted-run re-execution and defect routing13–17 remain. These boundaries do not certify actual current accepted count.
decisions.PRESERVED_MATRIX_IDENTITY_FIELDS: Every required valid verification relation retains exact current versions, current iteration, correct run and independent verifier. F2 input basis cannot replace independence. These identity/currentness/role checks are distinct from changed actual relation selection, evidence sufficiency and determination.
decisions.PRESERVED_RELEASE_INVARIANTS: Release remains application-derived, evidence-hash-idempotent, with only the existing three dispositions; ACCEPTED grants product-release eligibility only. Changed closure supersedes prior release; all blockers, contradictions and unknowns remain recorded even under controlling rejection. No old acceptance or receipt authorizes delivery.
decisions.PRESERVED_GRAPH_IDENTITY_BOUNDARY: A raw-response ID is not an evidence-record ID, and belief explanation stays derived UI data rather than a new canonical graph. Current complete chain/support/unknown content must separately bind current evidence.
decisions.CURRENT_EXACTLY_TEN_ACCEPTED_COUNT: The literal ten requirement is independently retained below. Actual Stage11 accepted-run/context completion must apply current A response admission and F2 EXECUTE_RUN input basis to exactly ten current accepted runs and distinct current contexts; rejected/blocked/failed or historical attempts never count.
decisions.CURRENT_STABILITY_DERIVATIONS: Actual requirement/test satisfied/violated/undetermined/agreement and defect/variance calculations bind B reviewed due-availability, D native semantics/identities, E exact normalized independently reviewed variance, F1 compatible actual executions and F2 route-specific input support. Compare all ten current runs, retain full closed universes and exclude historical/wrong-scope invalidated inputs without hiding missing required entries. No new agreement threshold or inferred XML/binding meaning.
decisions.CURRENT_STAGE07_MUTATION_COMPLETION: Distinguish unchanged fixture/byte/result/rejection presence and validator-defect linkage from actual capable execution, actual rejection match and evidence sufficiency. Those current computations must exercise applicable A–F2 validity, exact bound known-invalid fixture and current compatible target/execution input, with actual attributable evidence and isolation. No hypothetical execution or parser/source interpretation is supplied.
decisions.CURRENT_REGRESSION_PRE_POST_EXECUTIONS: Actual pre-correction failure and distinct later corrected success bind current B availability, D outcome semantics, E applicable reviewed test/variance, F1 exact definition/test/fixture/target/history compatibility and distinct actual target input identities, plus F2 appropriate custody/support. Preserve independent review, restoration and stronger evidence; no reused observation can prove both.
decisions.CURRENT_DEFERRED_TIMING_TRIGGER: All four exact timing/future-work guards are independently retained below. B2050 expressly preserves the due predicate and phase timing, while actual reviewed availability and F1 compatible route computation remain separately governed. Unknown availability is not known absence.
decisions.CURRENT_ISOLATION_PROOF_COVERAGE: Actual suite proof of no fixture mutation of canonical user projects or unauthorized third-party targets must cover the newly explicit F1 conditional execution routes as well as existing routes. Preserve exact isolation/restoration and target/risk authority; no route label authorizes mutation. Historical specialized reference qualifiers remain explicit.
decisions.CURRENT_RETIREMENT_EVIDENCE_AND_DEPENDEN: Actual sufficient current retirement evidence and absence of baseline/product dependencies must bind changed current proposition/test/evidence semantics, B availability, D results, E relevant variance, F1 history/compatibility and F2 proper input basis. A missing current binding or stale receipt does not show a dependency disappeared. Preserve all separate human/review/NOT_APPLICABLE/record duties.
decisions.CURRENT_REQUIRED_VERIFICATION_RELATIONS: Actual complete required REQ×RUN×TEST relation selection, current validity, sufficiency and determination bind current applicable due PER_RUN_REQUIRED universe and A–F2 admissibility. Preserve exactly one valid current record per required triple, independent verification and no manufactured meaningless Cartesian cells or denominator reduction.
decisions.CURRENT_RELEASE_DERIVATION_AND_TRIGGERS: Actual complete Stage27 release calculation binds all current applicable A–F2 source/proof/evidence/dependency identities. The three exact decision-table branches are separately retained below: sufficient mandatory refutation first, otherwise required unresolved state, otherwise all applicable mandatory propositions satisfied. Never count input echoes, frozen bytes or old acceptance as current sufficient proof.
decisions.CURRENT_EVIDENCE_CHAIN_AND_EXPLANATION: Actual complete authority→requirement→instruction→execution/product→tests/results→sufficient canonical evidence→current release→released artifact chain, Stage29 structure/current scope/sufficiency and UI support/unresolved explanation depend on current A–F2 content. The artifact-identity applicability check is separately retained below. Preserve human authority, exact current bytes, every applicable relation, stronger review/evidence and all unresolved matters.
